14:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: College Basketball
The No. 10 Louisville Cardinals (2-0) visit the Memphis Tigers (2-1) at FedExForum for a college basketball game. Louisville aims for a three-game win streak behind Adrian Wooley, while Memphis relies on Jayden Reid who leads with 23 points.

16:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Basketball
The Baylor Bears face the No. 7 Texas Longhorns for an NCAA Division I game in Texas. Baylor rides a three-game win streak alongside guard Kayden Mingo, and Texas also rides a three-game win streak alongside center Matas Vokietaitis in San Antonio.
